Messages.Author: Raille
Messages.Body:
Had a few odd questions pop up that I could not answer for people
satisfactorly.

Call of the Hungry dead.
Minion.
Does the -1 intercept carry over to subsequent block attempts by other
minions?
I ruled that it does.

Change of Target
Does the card played for the action get discarded or returned to the
hand?
I think that the card is discarded.

Compel the Spirit.
When compeling a Shambling Horde do you have to burn another ally ect to
return the SH to play?

Bonecraft
At Superior -2 strenth
Can you have negative strength?
We had a minion with this card on them who struck for zero, then played
Lucky blow for 1 damage.
Is this correct?

Raille

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Call of the Hungry dead.
>Minion.
>Does the -1 intercept carry over to subsequent block attempts by other
>minions?
>I ruled that it does.

No. Only that one particular blocking minion gets the -1 intercept. Other
minions who block are not affected by that Call of the Hungry Dead.

>Change of Target
>Does the card played for the action get discarded or returned to the
>hand?
>I think that the card is discarded.

Discarded. Without any explicit text to return the card to your hand, it is
discarded.

>Compel the Spirit.
>When compeling a Shambling Horde do you have to burn another ally ect to
>return the SH to play?
>

Yes you do have to remove another ally etc to return the SH to play. When
Compelled, it is still "entering play."

Also, see similar ruling on War Ghoul:

If you have no other allies and no retainers in play when War Ghoul is
recruited, then you burn War Ghoul to satisfy card text. [RTR 19961113]

>Bonecraft
>At Superior -2 strenth
>Can you have negative strength?
>We had a minion with this card on them who struck for zero, then played
>Lucky blow for 1 damage.
>Is this correct?

You can have negative strength. You can't do less than 0 damage, but this is
important for things that give + strength damage. Thus a typical minion with a
Bonecraft (1 - 2 = -1 strength) who strikes with an inferior Undead Strength or
a Lucky Blow still does 0 damage.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Body:

You have to remove one in your ash-heap from the game. (Card text.)

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
> Also, see similar ruling on War Ghoul:
>
> If you have no other allies and no retainers in play when War Ghoul is
> recruited, then you burn War Ghoul to satisfy card text. [RTR 19961113]

Hmm is WG considered to be recruited when he's compelled?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Compel uses the 'move' phrasing.
Hence the additional verbage on the card regarding requirements, disciplines, etc.

However, Compel (superior) *does* put the WG into play. So the "enters play"
effect on the War Ghoul must be handled. If the compelled WG is the only
retainer/ally you have in play, then he is burned.


